name: LNTCMMB Firebase Deploy
postCreateCommand: npm install -g firebase-tools && firebase target:apply hosting lntcmmb-dashboards lntcmmb-dashboards --project lntcmmb-intelligence1 2>/dev/null || true
postStartCommand:
git pull --quiet && firebase deploy --only hosting:lntcmmb-dashboards --project lntcmmb-intelligence1 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo '
✅ https://lntcmmb-dashboards.web.app is up to date'
